description: This PHP source file defines the 'Information' class in the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class contains methods to add, edit, and delete information entities by scheduling tasks within an Opencart system, interfacing with the 'setting/task' model to enqueue specific tasks based on information operations.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A controller class that handles scheduling background tasks related to adding, editing, and deleting information entries in the Opencart admin environment.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to add a new information entry and generate its detailed info.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update an existing information entry based on provided arguments.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to delete an information entry identified by its ID.
